title: DNS Record TTL Reduction for Staging Service Cutover
business_justification: Lower TTL from 86400 to 300 seconds in advance of upcoming application migration.

pre_checks.description: Query current SOA and A record TTL via local resolver

implementation_steps.action: Update zone file record TTL to 300 seconds and increment SOA serial

rollback_plan.trigger_conditions: DNS zone reload syntax error or SERVFAIL returned from local resolver.

commands.action: Revert zone file to backup copy and reload bind daemon

verification_plan.description: Confirm updated 300s TTL is returned from authoritative nameserver
